newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania hopes to join NATO in maximum two years, Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea said at the ruling National Peasant Party's weekly news conference. Ciorbea said the issue would be discussed during a visit by U.S. President Bill Clinton in Bucharest on July 11.
* President Emil Constantinescu met on Monday a new team of ambassadors to the NATO countries.
* Germany will open soon a consular office in Timisoara.
* The Leorda coal mine, in the northeastern town of Comanesti will close down starting Tuesday and 225 miners will be laid off. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264 REUTER
